source_instruction: Run the real COMMS OPEN signal → Dayline → act and witness → RETURN TO SOURCE loop, then report whether PR #296 is ready to merge.
object: one exact HUMAN ASK across COMMS → Dayline → completed Dayline task → OFFER_ONLY → exact COMMS native acceptance
defect_found: The prior real-source smoke left the Dayline task OPEN. Completing it ejected the selected object before RETURN, so a truly completed task could not emit its source receipt.
delta: completed source-linked task remains selected/held through RETURN
Dayline RETURN packet carries task status DONE and proposes COVERED without applying it
source receipt is emitted before Dayline releases completed focus
post-RETURN focus moves to the next open task or none
COMMS still requires exact source SHA + signal id + message/range and explicit native acceptance
real-source smoke now requires RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN → COVERED
boundaries: no claim of real-phone tactile proof
merge_readiness_law: CI can prove the exact-source closed-loop implementation. It cannot by itself prove that the round trip feels like continuity rather than duplicate bookkeeping on the user's actual phone.
next: Run current-master CI. If green, classify implementation READY_BY_MACHINE / STILL_REALITY_GATED; do not silently convert that into lived-phone proof.
